messages:
jess: Repro: Kotlin SDK + R8 (minify=true) in release builds sometimes sends duplicate outbound request during token refresh. Users see double billing. :grimacing:

theo: Only in release? emulator or device?

jess: Only in minified release builds on real devices (Android 12/13). Debug builds fine.

maya: Any custom proguard rules in the sample app?

jess: We had only the basic okhttp keep rules. Adding `-keep class com.redwood.sdk.** { *; }` stopped the dupes.

theo: Hmm. Could R8 be stripping a type used for Request.tag() dedupe?

jess: Exactly. We tag requests with an internal RequestId class. In release the tag check returned null so the auth flow retried the same call.

maya: Short-term fix: add proguard rule for the tag class. Long-term: SDK should fall back to header-based dedupe which survives R8.

jess: Proposed plan: 1) add header X-Redwood-Req-Id fallback in SDK v1.2.x; 2) add explicit ProGuard snippet to Android quickstart; 3) add CI e2e that runs a minified release flow.

theo: Also document the proguard snippet in onboarding and sample app. Include gradle example.

maya: Gradle snippet for docs:
```gradle
buildTypes {
  release {
    minifyEnabled true
    proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android-optimize.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
  }
}
```

// proguard-rules.pro
-keep class com.redwood.sdk.auth.RequestId { *; }
-keep class com.redwood.sdk.** { *; }

jess: Filed RED-2301 for sample-app + proguard docs + header fallback. Tagging @maya for docs and @theo for CI.

ci-bot: CI queued: android-release-minified-e2e -> #5130

jess: After patch release, add a note in migration docs: "If you use code shrinking, either add ProGuard rules or upgrade to SDK v1.2.x+ which includes header-based dedupe."
